root_idea.summary: The supplied root-level evidence identifies عَدَس primarily as the known lentil grain and records عَدَسْ as a cry used to urge a mule. It does not establish a single broader root principle.
root_idea.development: Classical evidence preserves several distinct lexical branches, including lentils, a mule-driving cry, movement and journeying, service and pasturing, medical terms, and related derived expressions; a unified semantic development is not demonstrated.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested form is the noun عَدَسٌ, the known lentil grain.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it occurs in the coordinated expression وَعَدَسِهَا, “and its lentils.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go away or journey into, in, or through a country or land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the expression عَدَسَتْ بِهِ المَنِيَّةُ, “death carried him away.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tread hard or vehemently upon the ground.
To work, toil, or labor hard.
To be strong to do evil or mischief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation, attributed to one authority; the same passage records journeying as a competing interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture cattle, camels, or other livestock; to pasture for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with livestock as the object, and in the construction يَعْدِسُ عَلَيْهِ, “he pastures for him.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cry عَدَسْ used to chide and urge a mule; hence, to utter this cry to a mule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cry may be used substantively in the construction عَدَسَ بِهِ or عَدَسَهُ, “he said عَدَسْ to it.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be afflicted with an eruption of a small pustule called عَدَسَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical identification is a Form III derived verb.
A transferred use deriving from the cry used to urge a mule.
The supplied evidence gives no further description of the plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small lentil-like pustule; an eruption occurring in the body and regarded as a kind of plague, sometimes fatal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The pustules are described as appearing dispersedly and as being feared because of their severity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A soup made by boiling yellow lentils until nearly dissolved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported preparation adds red vinegar, coriander, and salt.
Reportedly used medicinally, internally or externally, including mixed with vinegar for application to tumours.
A reported usage associated with the term for bats’ dung.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strong or enduring in journeying, especially by night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or camel, and as a feminine epithet for a hyena.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having an eruption of the pustule called عَدَسَةٌ.

cautions: The supplied root-level discussion explicitly denies a general lexical principle for this root, so the entry preserves its distinct lexical branches rather than presenting an artificial unified derivation.
The interpretation of عَدَسَ in one Lane passage as “to be strong to do evil” is reported as doubtful and is retained separately from the better-attested journeying meaning.
